prompt_en:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a photorealistic, non-explicit adult fashion-editorial photograph in a snow-bright late-afternoon apartment bedroom. Show one unmistakably adult woman with long dark wavy hair, visible adult facial proportions, and visible natural skin texture. Image 1 is an appearance reference only for those three visible adult appearance cues. Photograph her with a 75 mm lens from just below eye level in a compact mid-torso frame beside a linen-curtained window. She wears a moss-green brushed-cotton wrap blouse over a cream opaque foundation top; a folded linen scarf rests on one chair. Her right thumb and forefinger physically pinch the upper wrap edge and its small fabric loop at the same left-collarbone boundary, holding the unfinished fastening midway.

In the same frame, one unmistakably adult subject remains the visible actor, with long dark wavy hair, visible adult facial proportions, and natural skin texture. A concrete unfinished dressing grooming or room task remains self-directed as her fingers continue fastening her own wrap blouse. One stable opaque or layered edge creates a traceable reveal-and-coverage boundary at the moss-green overlap beside her left collarbone. The boundary reveals a bounded shoulder collarbone side back or clearly distinct foundation-layer relation, specifically one small collarbone triangle and the cream opaque layer. The visible hand action physically changes or holds that exact garment boundary as her fingers draw it partway closed. Face action torso and environmental context remain readable in one holistic frame with the window, chair, and bedroom depth. Fabric weight overlap contact shadow and gravity explain the coverage relation through edge thickness, pulled tension, and downward drape. Face and the changed boundary are the first two readable focal relations at thumbnail scale, with her hand fully visible between them. Closing or removing that boundary would erase the controlled reveal proposition from the photograph because the material relation carries the focal meaning.

One unmistakably adult subject remains the portrait's visible actor, standing upright and controlling her own clothing action. Bedroom hotel-room or dressing-space depth and furnishing cues remain readable through the apartment chair, curtained window, and surrounding spatial depth. A visible window and translucent curtain create a broad directional gradient with soft-edged shadows across her face from the snow-reflected late-afternoon light. The adult continues one concrete dressing grooming or room action rather than passive reclining, specifically fastening her own wrap blouse while upright. One garment sheet or curtain edge shows thickness overlap contact shadow and gravity through the doubled blouse edge, pulled tension, and downward drape. Preserve realistic pores, small flyaway hairs, brushed-cotton nap, finger pressure, cloth weight, and the narrow contact shadow where the layers meet.
